summary.text: Scott Baldermann is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 2, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Carey Marin (R).
A software developer, he served on the Denver Public Schools Board of Education from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Scott Baldermann was born in Dallas, Texas, and earned bachelor's and graduate degrees from the University of Nebraska, Lincoln in 1998 and 2000; his career experience includes working as a software developer.
He represented District 1 on the Denver Board of Education from December 4, 2019 to December 1, 2023.

In a 2023 Ballotpedia survey, Baldermann said he is the father of two children in Denver Public Schools, was PTA president at Lincoln Elementary from 2016 to 2018, and supported teachers in the 2019 Denver teacher strike.
